items.title_kr: Macy's가 Thanksgiving Day Parade를 기념해 exclusive Disney Capsule Collection을 공개했습니다.
items.title_en: Disney and Macy’s debut Thanksgiving parade collection
items.body_kr: Macy's는 연말 Holiday season을 겨냥해 Thanksgiving Day Parade 소장용 Disney merchandise와 exclusive capsule collection을 출시했습니다. 캐릭터 IP를 활용한 seasonal merchandise sourcing과 독점 기획 상품 준비에 참고해야 합니다.
items.body_en: Macy's launched an exclusive Disney capsule collection tied to its upcoming Thanksgiving parade. This highlights the early rollout of holiday character merchandise and exclusive partnerships for the season.

items.title_kr: Kohl's, 고객 수요 둔화 대응해 key item 중심으로 pricing 인하 단행
items.title_en: Kohl’s drops prices on key items as customer interest fades
items.body_kr: Kohl's는 최근 고객 traffic과 구매 관심이 둔화함에 따라 주요 category의 가격을 낮추는 공격적인 pricing 전략을 시행했습니다. 소비자의 value 민감도가 높아진 market 상황에서 activewear 및 기본 merchandise의 가격 경쟁력 확보가 중요해졌습니다.
items.body_en: Kohl's has lowered prices on key items to counter softening customer interest and weak traffic. This pricing adjustment reflects broader consumer value-seeking trends across retail categories.

items.title_kr: Abercrombie & Fitch와 Hollister, Y2K Nostalgia 넘어선 brand 리뉴얼로 Gen Z 공략
items.title_en: How Abercrombie and Hollister Are Rewriting the Rules for Legacy Mall Brands
items.body_kr: A&F와 Hollister는 단순한 Y2K 트렌드에 의존하지 않고 현대적인 merchandise와 매장 포지셔닝을 통해 Gen Z 소비자층을 지속적으로 사로잡고 있습니다. 전통 mall brand들의 성공적인 체질 개선 사례는 향후 category 확장과 마케팅 방향성에 시사점을 줍니다.
items.body_en: Abercrombie and Hollister are successfully sustaining retail momentum by moving beyond nostalgic Y2K trends into fresh, contemporary merchandising. Their brand evolution serves as a strong benchmark for lifestyle and apparel positioning.

items.title_kr: DoorDash, Macy's 및 주요 apparel brand들의 on-demand delivery 서비스 도입
items.title_en: DoorDash adds Macy's, Anthropologie, Vans, Timberland, North Face
items.body_kr: DoorDash는 Macy's를 비롯한 주요 apparel brand들과 partnership을 맺고 당일 배송 서비스를 강화합니다. e-commerce 및 omni-channel fulfillment 능력이 판매 성과에 미치는 영향이 커지고 있습니다.
items.body_en: DoorDash has expanded its retail delivery network to include Macy's and other major apparel brands. This reflects the growing importance of rapid e-commerce fulfillment and omni-channel retail partnerships.

items.title_kr: Kohl's, beauty partnership 강화하며 100개 store 추가 확장 진행
items.title_en: Sephora is expanding to 100 stores at this major retailer
items.body_kr: Kohl's is scaling up its retail partnership by introducing Sephora shop-in-shops to another 100 stores. Such strategic store expansions help drive brick-and-mortar customer traffic and cross-shopping.

items.title_kr: KnitWell Group, Ann Taylor 모회사로서 chief digital and customer data officer 임명
items.title_en: KnitWell Group names chief digital and customer data officer
items.body_kr: KnitWell Group, parent of Ann Taylor, has appointed a new chief digital and customer data officer to spearhead digital strategy. The move aims to strengthen customer data analytics and e-commerce personalization.
